content: Yerusalɛmutaamba cãl Piɛr
*Niɛraambaŋ hũyãa Yesu maama‑i, Yesu *pɔpuɔrbiemba‑i baa Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba maŋ waa *Yude‑i-na baa nu-ma.
Piɛrŋ juɔ bir kã *Yerusalɛmu‑i-na, Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba maŋ waa *Yuifubaa-ba‑i, baa ta ba waŋ baa-yo
wuɔ u ciɛ niɛ suur *niɛraamba dũnni-na, aa tiraa wuo niiwuoni‑i baa-ba?
Maŋ ciɛ dumaa hiere, Piɛr wuɔ suur ma yaaŋga-na a waŋ-ma baa-ba wuɔ:
«Mi waa Yope‑i-na ta mi cãrã Diiloŋo‑i, mi juɔ'a mi ne da bĩŋkũŋgu naŋgu hilaa dɔrɔ‑i-na ta ku jo. Ku waa ŋaa kompaŋga, da bãmbãale aa to ka nunni naa‑i-na. Kaŋ juɔ saanu baa-mi, ka yiɛra.
Mi ne ka huɔŋga-na da suu a da bĩmbaamba‑i ba sĩnni-na hiere: Hĩɛŋ-baamba‑i, baa huriimba‑i a naara baabũulãamba waa hiere.
Miŋ daa-ba dumaaŋo-na, mi nu molo piiye baa-mi wuɔ: ‹Piɛr, sire ŋ bel ŋ ko ŋ wuo!›
Miɛ: ‹Moloŋ nuɔ, mɛi siɛ wuo. Niiwuoni maŋ nyaa-ye baa nimaŋ saa fa hiere, miŋ siire mi saa dii ku diei mi nuŋgu-na dede.›
Moloŋ daa u tĩɛ dii dɔrɔ‑i-na aa cira: ‹Diiloŋ duɔ migãaŋ kumaŋ, nuɔ baa ce-ku kuubabalaaŋgu.›
Ku tirii ce i siɛi aa kompaŋga bir nyugũŋ baa bĩmbaamba‑i hiere dɔrɔ‑i-na.
«Kaŋ bi birii nyugũŋ, miɛ mi ne da nuɔmba siɛi juɔ ji ta ba suur miŋ haraa dumɛlle maŋ nuɔ‑i, wuɔ ba hilaa Sesare. Ba puɔraa-ba muɔmɛi wulaa‑i.
*Diiloŋ-Yalle gbɛ̃-mi wuɔ: ‹Baa ce ŋ hɔmmu‑i mu hãi, sire na kã.› Naŋ daa nuɔmba niediei maŋ daaba‑i, ba yaa saaŋ-mi i kã Kɔrnɛi terieŋgu-na.
Iŋ kãa, u biɛ piiye pigãaŋ-ye, wuɔ u tĩɛnaana u dũŋgu-na, a ji da *dɔrpɔpuɔrbiloŋo naŋo caraaya-yuɔ a waŋ baa-yo wuɔ u puɔr ba ka bĩ-mi Yope‑i-na
mi ka waŋ nelma namma baa-yo, kɛrɛ nelma famma ka kor-o baa u dumɛlleŋ-baamba‑i hiere.
Miŋ kãa ka hi doŋ ta mi piiye, ku saa vaaya, Diiloŋ-Yalle suur ba hɔmmu-na ŋaa diŋ bi suurii miɛŋo-na dumaa ku domma-na.
Itieŋ uŋ waaŋ nelma maŋ, wuɔ Nsãa *baatiseŋ-ye baa hũmma, ŋga yiiŋgu dii baa yiiŋgu Diiloŋo ka batiseŋ-ye baa u *Yalle‑i; nelma famma pãŋ tĩɛnu-miɛ.
Miɛ iŋ hũyãa Itieŋo‑i Yesu-Kirsa maama‑i aa Diiloŋo hã-ye kumaŋ, u bi hãa bafamba‑i kuuduɔŋgu faŋgu yaa‑i. Muɔmi naa gbãa cie Diiloŋo‑i wuɔ u baa hã-ba wɛi?»
Piɛrŋ juɔ piiye dumaaŋo-na, ba hɔmmu suɔ ciire. Baa ta ba piiye wuɔ: «Diiloŋo‑i bibiɛŋo! U bi kãayã niɛraamba da ba nanna ba cilɔbabalaŋo‑i aa duɔ kor-ba.»
Ãntiyɔsi Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba maama
Baŋ kuɔ Etiɛni‑i aa pisãllã
Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba maŋ, banamba kã ka hel dii Fenisi, banamba Sipire, banamba Ãntiyɔsi. Baa naa fulnu *Yuifubaa-ba yaa yoŋ ta ba waŋ Yesu maama‑i baa-ba.
Sipiretaamba namba waa ba hɔlma-na baa Sirɛnitaamba namba. Baŋ kaa hi Ãntiyɔsi‑i, baa bi piiye-mɛi baa *niɛraamba‑i.
Itieŋo taa u kãyã-bɛi, a ce dumaaŋo-na, nuɔmba bɔi baa hũyãa Diiloŋ-nelma‑i a cu Itieŋo huoŋ-nu.
Nel daama kã ka hi Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba‑i *Yerusalɛmu‑i-na. Baŋ nuɔ-ma, baa saaŋ Barnabasi‑i ba wulaa dii Ãntiyɔsi‑i-na.
Barnabasiŋ kãa ka hi da Diiloŋ uŋ ciɛ baa-ba cemma maŋ, kuɔ gbuu fũnuŋ dɔlnu-yuɔ. Wuɔ dii sirɛiŋa bɛi, wuɔ ba baa hel Itieŋo huoŋ-nu.
Barnabasi waa nelviiŋo, *Diiloŋ-Yalle naa yu u huɔŋga‑i baa Yesu maama‑i, a ce dumaaŋo-na, nuɔmba bɔi baa hũyãa Itieŋo maama‑i.
Ku huoŋgu-na, Barnabasi ji ta kã Tarse duɔ ka taara Sol‑i.

Uŋ kaa da-yo, wuɔ ce ba bir kã Ãntiyɔsi‑i-na ka tĩɛna ce benfifille baa Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba‑i. Ba hãalãayã nuɔmba bɔi Diiloŋ-hũmelle‑i terieŋgu-na. Ba duɔŋ Ãntiyɔsi yaa nuɔ‑i ta ba bĩ Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba‑i «Kertĩɛbaa-ba‑i».
Huɔŋgu faŋgu-na, *Diilopɔpuɔrbiemba namba hel Yerusalɛmu‑i-na a kã Ãntiyɔsi‑i-na.

Ba taa ba bĩ unaŋo‑i Agabusi. Diiloŋ-Yal diɛ sire-yuɔ a ce u tuɔ piiye wuɔ nyulbabalammu ka suur nilɛiŋa-na hiere. (Ninsie ninsie, nyulmu fammu yaa juɔ suur *Oromɛ ba *jãmatigi maŋ ba naŋ bĩŋ-yoŋ Kulodi‑i u bãaŋgu-na.)
Uŋ piiye dumaaŋo-na, Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba‑i Ãntiyɔsi‑i-na, baa saa-ma wuɔ umaŋ duɔ saanu kumaŋ, u jo baa-ku ba saaŋ-ku hã tobimba maŋ *Yude‑i-na ba kãyã ba fɛrɛ.
Baŋ saanu baa kumaŋ hiere, baa jãnu-kuɔ a puɔr Barnabasi baa Sol ba ka hã yaataamba‑i baa-ku dii Yude‑i-na.
